roads.name: Wardlaw Ranch Road 1
words: Sweeping and steady: 26 curves in 5.8 miles.
The 3 miles at the north end are tamer.
From 1,280 to 1,683 ft, with 569 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 96°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.96 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
